stem: Which quotation best shows that the author of the excerpt from the article “Those Old Piano Blues” is relieved someone wants his old piano?

options.label: F
options.text: The song had gone from major to minor, but we pressed on. (paragraph 4)

options.label: G
options.text: Then the song shifted to the saddest of blues. (paragraph 4)

options.label: H
options.text: But like many a blues song, this piano riff ends with hope. (paragraph 6)

options.label: J
options.text: And to be sure, many older pianos have reached their coda. (paragraph 7)
